name: cmdb_sync_data_hash
label: Configuration Management Sync_data_hash Table
description: The sync_data_hash table is part of the configuration management module and is used for statistical reporting and query scenarios related to time dimensions in configuration management.

fields.name: data_id
fields.description: The data ID value, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: update_time
fields.description: Update time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: collection_name
fields.description: Collection name, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the data_id, collection_name fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_updatetime
indexes.description: Standard index covering the update_time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
